name: music-loop-basic
notes: Background music loops with Stable Audio 3 Small-Music (Community Licence + Gemma terms). 8 steps, cfg 1, lcm/simple, as tested in 8c-3. The model gets '<prompt>, <bpm> BPM, instrumental, no vocals'. Receiver v0.9 clean-up (MU2-MU4): master FLAC as generated (metadata stripped, stereo) + OGG/Opus 128k stereo loop: largest whole number of bars inside the first 75 % (skips the model's ending), 0.5 s blend into the start, -16 LUFS, true peak -1.5 dB. Prompt rules (MU7): style + instruments + mood; BPM only in the bpm field; no reliance on fine details; make 3 versions with different seeds. Seconds: 30 gives a ~21 s loop, 60 gives ~42 s. Apps using this music show 'Powered by Stability AI'.
